acceptance.given: The Atomic Obligation graph and its runtime-evidence nodes are available to the Exact Cover validator.

oracle.expected: Exact-cover validation reports a forward relation from every Atomic Obligation to runtime evidence and a reverse relation from every runtime-evidence node to its covered Atomic Obligation, with no orphan on either side.
forbidden: An Atomic Obligation covered by runtime evidence without reverse coverage.
A runtime-evidence node linked without corresponding Atomic Obligation coverage.
oracle.observable: Bidirectional Exact Cover validation report for Atomic Obligation-to-runtime-evidence edges

acceptance.then: Every Atomic Obligation and runtime-evidence relation is mutually and exactly covered.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain compiles the obligation graph or runs Exact Cover validation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Validate an orphaned or one-directional Atomic Obligation-to-runtime-evidence edge and require the structural Exact Cover check to fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate both forward and reverse Exact Cover edges between every Atomic Obligation and its runtime-evidence nodes, rejecting orphaned or one-directional links.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The Exact Cover graph remains bidirectional; malformed runtime-evidence mappings are rejected without redefining existing obligation identities.

slice_hint.state_transition: obligation graph compiled -> forward and reverse runtime-evidence edges evaluated -> exact-cover report or structural failure
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The Exact Cover validator confirms both directions for every Atomic Obligation-to-runtime-evidence relationship and reports no orphaned node.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert only the Toolchain validator behavior; preserve the frozen seed-manifest schema and records.
